question: What is the purpose of the geo-portal 'Greening and Restoration of Wastelands with Agroforestry (GROW)' developed by NITI Aayog?

options.text: Identifying suitable areas for agroforestry interventions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Identifying suitable areas for agroforestry interventions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The geo-portal **'Greening and Restoration of Wastelands with Agroforestry (GROW)'** is developed by **NITI Aayog**.
 
• Its primary purpose is to **identify suitable areas for agroforestry interventions** in India.
 
• Agroforestry involves integrating **trees and shrubs** into crop and livestock farming systems to enhance **productivity, profitability, and environmental sustainability**.
 
• The portal aims to assist in the **restoration of degraded lands** and promote sustainable land management practices.
 
• GROW uses **geospatial technology** to map and analyze wastelands, providing data to policymakers and stakeholders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Promoting agro-based industries**__

 __
 
• This option pertains to the **development and support of industries** that process agricultural products.
 
• Such initiatives are crucial for **economic growth** but are not the focus of the GROW portal.
 
 
 
• **Tracking wildlife migration**__
 __
 
• Involves monitoring the **movement patterns of wildlife** species.
 
• This is typically managed by **wildlife conservation authorities** and is unrelated to agroforestry.
 
 
 
• **Monitoring urban agriculture development projects**__
 
 
• Refers to the oversight of **agricultural activities within urban settings**.
 
• Urban agriculture aims to **increase food security** and is separate from the agroforestry focus of the GROW portal.
